name: Tafamidis

similar.name: Benoxaprofen
problems: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1982 — for kidney harm, stomach and gut problems and blood problems

examples.title: A Study to Compare the Amount of Two Forms of Tafamidis in the Blood of Healthy Adults Under Fed Conditions
examples.why: The study was terminated for business reasons; there were no safety concerns.

summary: Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, Tafamidis received a high score of 83 for liver concerns and a low score of 15 for heart concerns [M]. A chemically similar drug named Benoxaprofen was withdrawn from the global market starting in 1982 due to damage to the kidneys, issues with the stomach and gut, and blood complications [3]. Two clinical trials involving Tafamidis ended without safety issues, one being discontinued purely for business reasons and the other transitioning participants into a different study [6][7].
